notes: Headcollar: old SKUs folded into four archetypes (working, rope, show, breakaway) sourced from the Halter article; a few unassigned models kept. No Parelli rope-halter archetype: the retrieved Parelli page confirms the 1981 founding but says nothing about its rope halter, so it was left out. Lead rope and lunge line stay tier kinds with types and trimmed models (Weaver lead list cut from 11 to 6). New kind 'Lunge roller and side reins' (sourced: Longeing, Surcingle, YourHorse Pessoa page); Chambon and de Gogue left out (no retrieved page). Driving harness: collar types as archetypes plus the Zilco Classic family; Zilco brand recorded from knowledge (the harnessstuff history page returned 503).
